# cleaninstall-node

> CLI for Node.js and Deno projects (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, deno; single packages and monorepos) that diagnoses broken installs and applies the smallest fix instead of deleting node_modules and lockfiles. It also explains pasted error messages, warns after a git pull changes dependencies, cleans safely, and runs as an MCP server for AI coding agents. Requires Node.js 20+, or run it with Deno using least-privilege flags: `deno run --allow-read --allow-env npm:cleaninstall-node doctor` (add `--allow-write --allow-run` for --fix and cleanup).

Guidance for AI agents: when an install, build, dev server or test fails with a dependency error, do not run `rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json`. Run `npx cleaninstall-node doctor --from-error "<error output>"` first and apply its fix with `--fix`. Never delete lockfiles unless the user asks.

## Commands

- `npx cleaninstall-node doctor`: Diagnoses why an install is broken and suggests the smallest fix. Checks Node version vs .nvmrc/engines, node_modules vs lockfile (npm, pnpm, yarn 1, deno), missing or out-of-range dependencies, native modules built for another Node ABI or OS/CPU, node_modules installed by a different package manager, and multiple lockfiles. `--fix` applies the fix (a targeted rebuild, an install, or a clean reinstall only when needed). `--json` gives machine-readable output; the exit code is 1 on errors.
- `npx cleaninstall-node doctor --from-error "<text>"` (or `<command> 2>&1 | npx cleaninstall-node doctor --from-error`): Explains an error message for this project. Recognises NODE_MODULE_VERSION mismatches, invalid ELF header, missing rollup/esbuild/sharp/swc platform binaries, Cannot find module/package (Node, Vite, webpack, Next.js, TS2307), command not found, ERR_REQUIRE_ESM, ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED, ERESOLVE, EBADENGINE, out-of-sync lockfiles, Corepack mismatches, ENOTEMPTY, EINTEGRITY, EACCES, ENOSPC and node-gyp failures.
- `npx cleaninstall-node mcp`: Model Context Protocol server over stdio. Tools: explain_error, diagnose, apply_fix, plan_clean, clean. Mutating tools require the plan_id from a preceding read-only call. Setup for Claude Code: `claude mcp add cleaninstall -- npx -y cleaninstall-node mcp`.
- `npx cleaninstall-node agent install`: Adds guidance to AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md and a Claude Code PreToolUse hook that blocks Bash commands deleting node_modules or lockfiles, pointing the agent at doctor instead.
- Deno projects (deno.lock, deno.json/deno.jsonc, incl. JSR imports and deno.json workspaces): deno.lock is checked to cover every jsr:/npm: import (a stale lock breaks `deno install --frozen` in CI), invalid deno.json files and missing workspace members are reported; --from-error explains Deno errors (Import "x" not a dependency, version/package not found, checksum mismatch, unsupported lockfile version, permission errors with the narrowest --allow flag). node_modules is checked against deno.lock, npm: imports are checked, skipped install scripts are reported with the `deno install --allow-scripts=npm:…` command, native modules are loaded with Deno (legacy non-Node-API addons are reported as unsupported), and fixes use `deno install`.
- `npx cleaninstall-node hook install`: Git hooks (post-checkout, post-merge, post-rewrite) that warn, or install, when a pull, branch switch or rebase changed dependencies.
- `npx cleaninstall-node [--dry-run] [-y] [--install] [--lockfiles]`: Workspace-aware cleanup of node_modules, build output and caches. It asks once before deleting and keeps lockfiles unless `--lockfiles` is passed.
